articles.summary: To close out a claim, a practice needs to “post” an ERA. This means reconciling what was paid, to the claim that initiated it. Most PMs (practice management systems) can post between 50% - 70% of postings automatically. The remainder are done by hand, and this process is colloquially called “Payment Posting”. Substrate Posting handles these.
articles.title: Announcing Substrate Posting: ERA & 835 Reconciliation that handles the messy cases
